author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
To bring back the beloved Razor Crest in Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu, ILM once again brought on modelmakers John Goodson and Dan Patrascu to build its filming miniatures. Adam Savage visited their workshop during the film's production to get a close look at the new ship and learn the challenges of building the Razor Crest in not one but two separate scales!

Shot and edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
